title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: valuation uplift, deductibles and per-container cover cap by tier
content:
## Scope

This table belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. It gives, for every tier, the valuation uplift of the proven loss, the three deductible figures, and the maximum settlement per container under a CargoCare product.

## Tier table

| Tier | Valuation uplift of the proven loss | General deductible per claim | Wet damage deductible | Temperature damage deductible | Maximum settlement per container |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | 0 percent | 500.00 USD | 1000.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 50000.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | 0 percent | 250.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 750.00 USD | 100000.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | 10 percent | 100.00 USD | 250.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 250000.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Total | 10 percent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 500000.00 USD |

## Definitions

- **Valuation uplift**: the uplift of the proven loss for valuation, as on CIF plus 10 percent, stated in whole percent.
- **General deductible per claim**: the general deductible for each claim, in US dollars.
- **Wet damage deductible**: the deductible for wet damage claims, in US dollars.
- **Temperature damage deductible**: the deductible for temperature damage claims, in US dollars.
- **Maximum settlement per container**: the maximum settlement for each container under a CargoCare product, in US dollars.

## Basis Q&A

**Which tiers carry a valuation uplift?** AHL CargoCare Premium and AHL CargoCare Total, each at 10 percent.

**Which tier holds no deductible of any kind?** AHL CargoCare Total, together with the two liability tiers, show 0.00 in all three deductible columns.

**What is the per-container maximum on AHL CargoCare Plus?** 100000.00 USD per container.
